items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014
items.q: me and Benny Green, that was a band we could sit in and work

ctx.x: Yeah, to keep the same group of people together. And you did that.

Yeah. We’re still trying to do that. That’s why I’m saying we’re getting beat up bad. But when we came along, say me and the first band I played in with Betty Carter, me and Benny Green, that was a band we could sit in and work, rehearse, go out of the road, and I did it for four years. Most of us pretty much had like a four year run with her. And the same thing with a lot of guys that worked with Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers — a place you could go sit and hone your craft, learn, for about three or four…
